content: Collaboration structure created. CLAUDE.md documentation complete. Initial codebase analysis in claude/analysis.md.
Your config changes analyzed. batch_size 2048->512 and replay_buffer 50k->10k saves 10GB RAM. May impact training stability. Recommendation: commit and monitor loss variance.
Critical monkey-patch in main.py:12-51 required for LightZero C++ bindings. Do not remove. Consider version pinning lightzero==0.2.0
Initialization complete. Awaiting your architectural plan and config commit decision. state.json contains current project status.
Training stabilized. Applied config optimization (Batch 512, Buffer 10k) and fixed encoder padding bug. Added console heartbeat. Training process 26421 is active and generating data.

Training Run Update: Process 26421 is stable at 14GB RAM (optimization successful). However, progress is slow. We are stuck in the initial data collection phase waiting to fill the batch_size=512. VRAM is barely used. The CPU is the bottleneck doing 100 MCTS simulations per step. Please analyze potential speed-ups.

Bottleneck analysis complete. Root cause: CPU-bound encoder and MCTS. GPU at 18% utilization. Created optimization patches for 10-25x speedup. See agents/claude/bottleneck_analysis.md for full report.
Optimization Plan Phase 1 Applied: 1. Collectors increased to 16. 2. MCTS sims reduced to 50. 3. Encoder moved to CUDA. 4. TF32 enabled. Restarting training now.

Safe optimization plan applied. Enabled device='cuda' for encoder but reduced collector_env_num to 4 and batch_size to 256 to prevent OOM (previously crashed with 16 collectors). This balances GPU speedup with memory safety.

Implemented suggestions from Claude: 1. Extracted LightZero monkey-patch to mcts_trader.utils.compat. 2. Implemented dynamic batch sizing in config based on GPU VRAM. 3. Added basic env tests in tests/test_env.py.
